lessons.title: Scaffold blocked lower tube-sheet access
lessons.issue: The scaffold platform did not reach the lower tube-sheet rows, so it was rebuilt mid-inspection.
lessons.recommendation: Have the inspection lead sign off the scaffold drawing before erection.

lessons.title: Eddy current probe calibration left to night shift
lessons.issue: Probe calibration was left for the incoming night shift, which had no qualified technician. Inspection paused one shift.
lessons.recommendation: Complete probe calibration in the same shift as tooling preparation.

links.note: Inspection tooling not verified before the work window

lessons.title: Wrong probe size shipped for HX tube inspection
lessons.issue: Probes for the wrong tube diameter were shipped. Correct probes arrived 1.5 days later.
lessons.recommendation: Check probe size against the unit's tube drawings when tooling is booked.

links.note: Inspection tooling not verified before the work window

lessons.title: More tubes plugged than planned
lessons.issue: Inspection found 3 percent of tubes needing plugs against 1 percent planned; plugging took three times as long.
lessons.recommendation: Size plugging contingency from the last two inspections, not one.

links.note: Plugging scope underestimated, so plug stock ran short

lessons.title: Scaffold erection overlapped drain and vent
lessons.issue: Scaffold erection in the heat exchanger bay took 20 hours instead of 12 because of congestion with the drain and vent crew.
lessons.recommendation: Do not overlap scaffold erection with drain and vent in the same bay.

links.note: Scaffold overrun compressed the window to stage inspection tooling
Late permits delayed scaffold start into the drain and vent window

lessons.title: Isolation permits issued four hours late
lessons.issue: Work permits for the heat exchanger bay were issued late because the isolation list was finalised on the day.
lessons.recommendation: Freeze and pre-walk the isolation list 48 hours before shutdown.

links.note: Late permits delayed scaffold start into the drain and vent window

lessons.title: Tooling arrived late for U3 HX inspection
lessons.issue: Eddy current tooling arrived late for the U3 heat exchanger inspection, costing about 1.5 days.
lessons.recommendation: Complete tooling preparation and confirm eddy current probes are on site and calibrated before isolation; add a tooling verification milestone before HX tube inspection.

links.note: Scaffold overrun compressed the window to stage inspection tooling

lessons.title: Eddy current probe tooling not on site delayed U3 HX tube inspection
lessons.issue: Eddy current probe tooling was not on site at isolation, so the U3 heat exchanger (HX) tube inspection start slipped 2.5 days and hit the critical path.
lessons.recommendation: Complete tooling preparation and confirm eddy current probes are on site and calibrated before isolation; add a tooling verification milestone before HX tube inspection.

lessons.title: Crane double-booked between units
lessons.issue: The turbine hall crane was booked for a U2 pump motor lift and a U1 valve lift in the same window. One lift waited 10 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Book the crane in one cross-unit schedule and flag overlapping lifts.

links.note: Shared equipment not booked across units

lessons.title: Valve seat spares arrived late
lessons.issue: Replacement valve seats were ordered after the valve was opened. The overhaul waited 1.5 days for spares.
lessons.recommendation: Pre-order seats and gaskets for every valve overhaul in scope.

links.note: Critical spares not physically verified before outage

lessons.title: Midnight handover caused channel head re-torque
lessons.issue: Channel head closure crossed midnight. The torque record was not handed over and the night shift re-torqued all bolts.
lessons.recommendation: Avoid starting closure within two hours of a shift change, or use a signed torque sheet.

links.note: Inspection slip pushed channel head closure across the midnight handover
Late closure moved hydrotest before the water was heated

lessons.title: Hydrotest failed after tube plugging
lessons.issue: A tube plug leaked during hydrotest and the test was repeated after re-plugging.
lessons.recommendation: Verify plug seating before hydrotest.

links.note: Plug shortage forced rushed plugging and a leaking plug

lessons.title: Inspection contractor under-resourced
lessons.issue: Northline Inspection supplied two technicians instead of the contracted four. Commercial claim CC-2025-031 raised.
lessons.recommendation: Confirm named technicians 7 days before outage; apply contract clause 12.

links.note: Inspection contractor readiness not confirmed before outage

lessons.title: Wrong breaker tagged during isolation
lessons.issue: A wrong breaker was tagged during U2 isolation. Found at verification, no injury. Investigation ongoing.
lessons.recommendation: Independently verify every isolation point.

links.note: Isolation boundaries not verified against current drawings

lessons.title: Crane operator certification lapsed
lessons.issue: The Apex Access crane operator's certification had lapsed; the lift waited for a certified operator.
lessons.recommendation: Check contractor certifications at gate induction.

lessons.title: Cooldown slower than planned
lessons.issue: Cooldown to work temperature took 4 hours longer than the plan assumed.
lessons.recommendation: Use the cooldown curve from the last outage, not the design value.

lessons.title: Drain and vent slowed by blocked vent valve
lessons.issue: A vent valve was seized, slowing draining by 4 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Stroke-test vent valves in the week before the outage.

lessons.title: Motor coupling did not fit
lessons.issue: The replacement motor shipped with a different coupling. A new coupling was machined on site.
lessons.recommendation: Check coupling dimensions on receipt, before the outage.

links.note: Critical spares not physically verified before outage

lessons.title: Valve actuator spare missing from stores
lessons.issue: The stores record showed an actuator spare that was not on the shelf.
lessons.recommendation: Physically check critical spares two weeks before the outage.

links.note: Critical spares not physically verified before outage
Critical spares not physically verified before outage

lessons.title: U4 manway bolts seized
lessons.issue: Manway bolts on HX-401 were seized; opening took an extra 12 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Apply penetrating oil and pre-loosen manway bolts at the start of the outage.

lessons.title: Restart held for work order close-out
lessons.issue: Unit restart waited 5 hours for work order close-out signatures.
lessons.recommendation: Track work order close-out daily in the last 48 hours.

lessons.title: Certified welder not available on night shift
lessons.issue: The only certified welder was on days, so a night repair waited a shift.
lessons.recommendation: Roster a certified welder on every shift when weld repair is in scope.

links.note: Shift rostering of qualified staff

lessons.title: Asbestos survey needed before insulation removal
lessons.issue: Older insulation needed a survey before removal, adding 7 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Check the insulation register and book surveys in advance.

lessons.title: Test equipment shared with another unit
lessons.issue: Relay test set was in use on U2, delaying U4 switchgear testing 6 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Reserve test equipment per unit in the outage plan.

links.note: Shared equipment not booked across units

lessons.title: High winds stopped external scaffolding
lessons.issue: Wind above 40 km/h stopped external scaffold erection for 12 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Schedule external scaffolding with weather float.

lessons.title: Inspector fatigue on extended shifts
lessons.issue: Inspectors worked 14-hour shifts and data quality issues required re-inspection of 40 tubes.
lessons.recommendation: Cap inspection shifts at 12 hours; fatigue policy FP-3 applies.

links.note: Shift rostering of qualified staff

lessons.title: Mechanical isolation needed extra blind flange
lessons.issue: An unexpected tie-in needed an extra blind flange, delaying permit issue 7 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Walk down isolation boundaries against current P&IDs.

links.note: Isolation boundaries not verified against current drawings

lessons.title: Not enough tube plugs on site
lessons.issue: Plug count was based on the plan, not the worst case; extra plugs were couriered.
lessons.recommendation: Hold plugs for twice the planned plugging scope.

links.note: Plug shortage forced rushed plugging and a leaking plug
Plugging scope underestimated, so plug stock ran short

lessons.title: Valve contractor billing dispute
lessons.issue: Delta Valve Services disputed overtime rates mid-outage; work slowed until resolved.
lessons.recommendation: Agree overtime rates in the contract before the outage.

lessons.title: Hydrotest water not at temperature
lessons.issue: Hydrotest water was below the minimum temperature; heating took 5 hours.
lessons.recommendation: Start heating hydrotest water one shift before the test.

links.note: Late closure moved hydrotest before the water was heated

lessons.title: Restart checks repeated after late scope change
lessons.issue: A late scope addition reopened a system; restart checks were repeated.
lessons.recommendation: Freeze outage scope 24 hours before restart.

lessons.title: Drain and vent crossed midnight and slowed
lessons.issue: Draining the heat exchanger across midnight took 3 hours longer at shift handover.
lessons.recommendation: Plan drain and vent to finish before the shift change.

lessons.title: U4 HX-401 has a different tube pitch from U3
lessons.issue: U4 HX-401 uses a different tube pitch; probes sized for U3 may not fit.
lessons.recommendation: Confirm probe size against U4 drawings.

lessons.title: Crane inspection due during U4 outage
lessons.issue: The crane's annual inspection falls in the U4 outage window.
lessons.recommendation: Move the crane inspection or book a mobile crane.
